notes: Fault scan: works right after connecting, without reading the SVT first. E-Sys MAX asks the car which modules it has through E-Sys's own connection and scans them all. Code several changes: a search box finds a change by module or words (for example "mirrors" or "KOMBI"), E-Sys's report is closed for you when it has no errors (it is still kept in the car's Reports folder), so only the "code the next module?" question is left, and reading the coding data first no longer waits about 12 seconds per module. Old coding copies that were saved before E-Sys knew their module are no longer offered a second time.
